Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.name: Hyperborea Library
other_names: The Citadel of the Shining Ones
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.sensory_description: A vast, crystalline fortress that glows with a soft, ethereal light.  The air is filled with the sound of distant chimes and the scent of frost.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.location: Located at the northernmost point of Laurasia, surrounded by the icy expanse of the Hyperborean Sea.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.description: A tiered citadel of translucent ice-stone that refracts polar sunlight into reading chambers below.  Scrolls here are etched on mica leaves that sing when turned.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.notable_features: Contains the only intact copy of the lost ‘Cicero Codex Borealis’.  Frost-lamps powered by aurora energy keep ink from fading.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.lore: Founded by the Shining Ones before the last axial tilt; scholars claim its vaults shift location whenever the Pole Star realigns.

Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.name: Citadel of Borealis
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.sensory_description: A towering structure of shimmering ice and stone, surrounded by a swirling aurora.  The air is crisp and filled with the scent of pine.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.location: Located in the heart of the Hyperborean Sea, surrounded by a vast expanse of ice and snow.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.description: A hexagonal bastion perched on a basalt column rising from the Sea of Glass.  Its ramparts double as an armillary sphere tracking convergent timelines.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.notable_features: Houses the Chrono-Bell whose toll resets minor paradoxes within a day’s march.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.lore: Built by Roger de Flor’s engineer-magi during the First Catalan Incursion; now garrisoned by knights of the Order of the Dragon.

Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.name: Ironroot Mountains
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.sensory_description: A range of jagged peaks that glint with metallic hues, surrounded by the scent of molten metal and the sound of clanging hammers.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.location: Stretching across the western edge of Laurasia, bordering the Sea of Orichalcum.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.description: Jagged peaks shot through with metallic trees whose sap smelts into orichalcum.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.notable_features: Canyons echo with ‘Smith-songs’—natural harmonics that temper blades left to resonate overnight.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.lore: Legend holds that the Kusanagi was re-forged here after shattering a dragon’s scale.

Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.name: Selene Gate
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.description: Marble arch flanked by twin crescent pylons; at syzygy it opens a mirror-path to Gondwana’s Shadow Coast.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.notable_features: Central altar floats on a column of lunar gravity, allowing weightless martial training.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.lore: Custodied by Salasa Atumari’s tide-priests who levy ‘silver tithes’ for each crossing.

Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.name: Hollow Spire
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.description: A kilometer-high needle of obsidian with a spiraling cavity down its core; ascending winds produce organ-like drones.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.notable_features: Acoustics translate spoken vows into binding geasa enforced by the land itself.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.lore: Petrarch is prophesied to utter a verse here that will shatter Dagon’s deterministic script.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.affiliation: Neutral—pilgrimage site for poets & oath-breakers alike

Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.name: Aurum Bazaar
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.description: Golden barges chained together on the River Zephyr, trading relics, spices, and fragments of future history.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.notable_features: Chrono-merchants accept memories as currency; too many bargains leave patrons hollow-eyed but prescient.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.lore: Site where Giovanna first senses the Cintamani’s pulse resonating with the Golden Fleece badges.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.affiliation: Merchant Syndicate of the White Company

Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.name: Rift of Ages
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.description: A desert gorge cleft by a meteor of Prima Materia; layers of exposed strata display epochs out of order.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.notable_features: Travelers descending its terraces experience time ratios that halve each level—an hour above equals years below.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.lore: Templar cartographers mapped a stair-path that lets one converse with ancestors five generations past.

Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.name: Mechanikos
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.description: Interlocking brass districts rotate on cogs the size of coliseums, aligning streets with constellations every midnight.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.notable_features: Central Orrery Tower predicts portal flares three days ahead—crucial for Zanetti scheduling.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.lore: Founded by a guild of Lazarite lepers who replaced failing limbs with gear-prostheses.

Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.name: Glass Sea of Zephyria
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.description: Waves frozen mid-crest in transparent quartz, allowing passage over submarine ruins visible beneath one’s feet.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.notable_features: Standing atop the tallest ‘wave’ grants line-of-sight to every other place in Laurasia for a heartbeat at dawn.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.lore: Varangian sagas say the sea was flash-frozen when a Shining One dropped the Golden Apple into its depths.

Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.name: Ebon-Heath Sanctuary
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.description: Blackbark yews form a labyrinth whose paths rearrange with each equinox; silver owls guard silent pools of memory.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.notable_features: Drinking the pool’s water lets mortals speak once with a deceased loved one—at the cost of their oldest memory.
Places_of_Prominence_Laurasia.lore: Dante buried a sealed canto here, accessible only when the labyrinth spells his true love’s name.
